purpose: A non-diagnostic concept map for research, learner-controlled support discovery, and product safety review.
population_boundary: Undergraduate medical students unless an evidence object says otherwise.

nodes.label: Poor sleep, daytime sleepiness and fatigue
Problematic smartphone use or digital distraction

evidence_edges.geography: one private medical school in Lahore

evidence_edges.reported_effect: r=0.30 between smartphone-addiction and PSQI scores
median d=-0.27 for stigma and help-seeking

support_nodes.label: Qualified human mental-health care
support_nodes.learms_role: verified discovery and handoff only unless separately clinically governed

support_nodes.label: Institutional psychological, academic or career counselling
support_nodes.learms_role: display first-party route, scope, confidentiality terms and verification date

support_nodes.label: HEI harassment reporting and inquiry route
support_nodes.learms_role: explain and link; do not imply adjudicatory authority

support_nodes.label: Independent support or advice
support_nodes.learms_role: only display after jurisdictional and operational verification

support_nodes.label: Local emergency or crisis support
support_nodes.learms_role: prominent human routing; Pakistan-wide contact dataset not verified in Area 4

product_constraints.rule: Do not infer or present a diagnosis from behavior, academic data, self-description or a research screening estimate.
Do not sum prevalence estimates or create a wellbeing, burnout or suicide-risk score without separate clinical governance and validation.
Preserve cross-sectional association and qualitative theme labels; do not rewrite them as causes.
Do not rank colleges using non-comparable convenience or cross-sectional wellbeing samples.
Do not label a route confidential without source-backed terms describing operator, access, disclosure and retention.
Do not substitute learning content, a chatbot or engagement workflow for human clinical assessment, emergency response or a formal harassment process.
Wellbeing prompts, breaks, quiet hours and support routes must not penalize progress or streaks.

open_gaps: Representative national longitudinal Pakistan medical-student data
Current national counselling capacity, utilization and outcome data
Verified Pakistan-wide crisis contacts and operational ownership
Current harassment reporting, retaliation, outcome and trust data
Comparable evidence for underserved and under-described student groups
